Access common and format-specific extraction metadata

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "text/html", uri: "https://example.com/html/simple_table.html" };
  const result = await extract(input);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.metadata);
  const format = result.results?.[0]?.metadata?.format;
  if (format?.format_type === "html") {
    console.log(format.html?.title);
  }
}

void main();
```
